purpose: Separate related regions or items visually.
avoid: Orientation alone does not decide whether separation is meaningful.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: The separator role conveys a meaningful content boundary; surrounding section headings/text provide the boundary context. No fictitious label is required for a non-focusable separator.
updatesAndDescendants: Base UI renders a non-focusable div role=separator and derives orientation from props. It has no adjustable value, keyboard operation or action callback. A purely decorative line can instead be hidden deliberately in its own context.
referenceDecision: This reference chooses an informative non-focusable separator. It does not silently classify all separators as decorative or turn the line into a splitter.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Actual selected BaseUI1.9 state is data-orientation=horizontal/vertical. The pinned wrapper utility text targets data-horizontal/data-vertical, which this runtime does not emit; the semantic adapter deliberately binds the observed actual orientation attribute without modifying upstream bytes. The native0px path dimensions describe a stroked line, not an invisible runtime element: the pinned wrapper explicitly supplies1px thickness, mapped to the semantic border width. Horizontal stretches across available width; vertical stretches to its flex/grid host block extent. Native100/120px specimen lengths remain host examples. No drag/resize or keyboard focus semantics are invented.
